segments.text: Protagonist of the story. After losing his mother at young age and his father ran away with new lover, he lives a normal life with his younger sister Uta while attending school and working part-time at a small restaurant named "Fairy Tale". He used to be in track and field club together with his childhood friend Isuzu but retired due to injury.

He thought that he has nothing to do with love and romance until one day, a self-proclaimed Love Angel Lovmieil falls into him and he becomes owner of the Love Note. Now he has to find his "Fateful Lover" in 90 days or his penis will be useless for life.

The useless and troublesome Love Angel who suddenly crashes into the protagonist's peaceful life, and thus becomes his assistant to find his "Fateful Lover". Her angel name is Lovmieil and she is working hard on her job to fill the Love Gauge so she can realize her wish. Even though she calls herself expert Love Angel, the truth is she has only helped animals until now and has zero experience in human love. Love manga and sweets.

Her wish after fulfilling the duty of Love Angel is returning to her original human life which she lost 10 years ago due to accident and she has been hospitalized until now. However, fulfilling the duty of Love Angel will also cost her her own memory and existence in everyone's mind when she lives as Love Angel and vice versa.
Her real name is Amaki Eri (天姫 絵里)
